title: Maximum Absolute Sum of Any Subarray
summary: Given an integer array, find the maximum absolute sum of any subarray.
statement: Given an integer array, find the maximum absolute sum of any subarray. The absolute sum of a subarray is the absolute value of the sum of its elements. If the sum is negative, its absolute value is the negation of the sum; otherwise, it remains the same.
constraints: Choose any contiguous subarray; the empty subarray with sum zero is allowed.
Return the maximum absolute subarray sum.
hints: Any subarray sum is the difference between two prefix sums.
At each prefix, compare it with both the smallest and largest earlier prefix.
Update the answer with both absolute differences, then extend the prefix extrema.
The farthest earlier prefix produces the maximum absolute difference ending here; scanning all endpoints covers every subarray.
editorial: The farthest earlier prefix produces the maximum absolute difference ending here; scanning all endpoints covers every subarray.

tests.explanation: Subarray [2,3] sums to five, the largest absolute value.
Subarray [-5,1,-4] sums to negative eight, giving absolute value eight.
